text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick recap from the all-hands QA about a few edge topics we didn't get to live: role transfers, PIP interactions, international parity, and sabbaticals. Dropping answers and follow-ups here.

Ben: If someone is on a performance improvement plan (PIP) during the cycle, can they still be promoted?

Sofia (HRBP): Short answer: promo while on an active PIP is unusual. If an individual completes the PIP with documented sustained improvement before final calibration, managers can submit with clear evidence. The packet should call out the PIP, remediation steps, and sustained impact.

Lisa (Manager): How do we document "sustained improvement"? Engineers want examples.

Nora (People Ops): Good Q 	6 include concrete milestones (dates + deliverables), peer/manager feedback snippets, and at least 4 weeks of consistent results post-PIP. We'll add a mini-template for PIP->promo cases to the toolkit.

Owen: Role transfer question: if someone transfers teams mid-cycle, which manager owns the packet? Do they lose promo eligibility?

Marcel (EMEA People Ops): Transfer cases: the receiving manager is responsible for the packet if the person is now owned by them at calibration time. If transfer happened after packet submission, include a short note and both managers can add comments. Transfers do not automatically disqualify someone, but evidence should show impact across both roles or in the new role.

Ben: And what about international hires moving regions? Does comp parity get recalculated?

Vik (Finance): We do a localized comp review for transfers across regions. Actual base may be adjusted for local market and local benefits; equity/grant philosophy remains consistent. People Ops + Finance will coordinate case-by-case and flag any currency/tax implications.

Sofia (HRBP): Note for managers: if a transfer triggers a local labor requirement (notice windows, contract changes), cc international-hr@redwood.com early so we can align timelines.

Lisa (Manager): Sabbaticals do they affect promo timing? Someone on my team asked about a planned 12-week sabbatical next quarter.

Nora (People Ops): Sabbaticals are neutral to eligibility. We recommend that managers document the person's contributions before and after leave in the packet. If key evidence falls entirely during leave, consider timing for submission or a late packet with a note.

Ben: Bias reduction in calibration are we doing manager masking or anonymized packets? Some teams suggested anonymized examples helped.

Nora (People Ops): For this cycle we're piloting partial anonymization in the first calibration pass for engineering ICs (role/impact bullets only, no demographic or hiring-date metadata). We'll share pilot scope and expected effects in the toolkit. Managers still must include full packet for final review.

Owen: Appeals flow for transfer or PIP cases any difference?

Sofia (HRBP): Appeals are the same. People Ops triages and escalates to the cross-functional panel. For transfer or PIP cases we may request additional context from both managers and the HRBP to ensure a fair review. Appeals window is 14 days from notices.

Nora (People Ops): Action items: 1) we'll publish a PIP->promo mini-template and FAQ by Monday; 2) transfer checklist for managers by Tuesday; 3) partial anonymization pilot note in the toolkit by Friday.

people-ops-bot: Helpful links: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews-toolkit and https://redwood.internal/hr/international-hr (check the transfer checklist in the second doc).

Vik (Finance): Quick finance note: if a cross-region transfer involves a market adjustment, it's handled as a localized market review, not as a retro payroll correction. Payroll ops will advise on currency/tax timing.

Ben: Thanks  this is super helpful. If I need a private case consult, who do I ping?

Nora (People Ops): DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. For case consults that touch payroll/tax, cc finance@redwood.com and international-hr@redwood.com. If you want a walkthrough of the templates, book a 15-min slot with the calibration office hours linked in the toolkit.

Lisa (Manager): Appreciated, will share with my team.

Nora (People Ops): Thanks everyone  will update the thread when materials are live.
